ios.title: Make your iPhone feel like you.
ios.description: A little setup, a whole new home screen. We’ll walk you through every icon.
ios.metadataDescription: Save your icons and set up matching iPhone shortcuts, one simple step at a time.
ios.openFallback: If Shortcuts does not open, open the Shortcuts app yourself and start a new shortcut.
ios.resetBody: Your selected apps stay the same. This clears the setup checklist.
ios.completeTitle: Your new home screen is ready.
ios.completeBody: Hide the original icons from your home screen and set your matching wallpaper to finish the look.
ios.emptyBody: Pick a theme and the apps you want to personalise. Your checklist will be waiting here.
ios.themeUnavailable: We could not load this theme. You can retry or follow the steps with simple symbols.
ios.withoutTheme: You can follow these steps with icons you have already saved.

steps.openBody: Open Shortcuts and start a new shortcut.
steps.actionBody: Add the Open App action. Tap App in that action and choose {app}.
steps.detailsBody: Open the shortcut’s details menu, then choose Add to Home Screen.
steps.photoBody: Tap the icon preview, choose Choose Photo, then select the {app} icon you saved.
steps.nameBody: Name the shortcut {app}, then tap Add.
steps.finishBody: Return here and mark this app as done. Repeat for your next app.

faq.title: A few things to know
faq.bannerQuestion: Why does a banner appear when I open an app?
faq.bannerAnswer: iOS may show a banner when an app opens through Shortcuts. This is part of iOS and Vibeset cannot remove it.
faq.automaticQuestion: Can Vibeset set up every icon automatically?
faq.automaticAnswer: iOS does not allow apps or websites to change other app icons automatically. Each shortcut needs this one-time setup.

android.title: A fresh home screen on Android.
android.description: Save your wallpaper and icons, then make the look your own.
android.metadataDescription: Set your Android wallpaper and use matching icons with a compatible launcher.

steps.saveBody: Download the wallpaper and icon ZIP. Extract the ZIP so your icon images are easy to find.
steps.wallpaperBody: Open the wallpaper in Gallery or Downloads and choose Set as wallpaper. Your phone may also offer Wallpaper & style from the home screen.
steps.iconsBody: Most built-in launchers cannot change icons individually. Use a launcher that supports custom icons, or a shortcut-maker app.
steps.customizeBody: In your launcher or shortcut app, edit an app’s icon and choose its matching PNG. Repeat for your other apps.

desktop.title: Bring your look to your desktop.
desktop.description: Save a wallpaper for your computer, or prepare an icon pack for your phone.
desktop.metadataDescription: Set a Vibeset wallpaper on Mac or Windows and download matching icon images.

steps.saveBody: Choose Desktop in the wallpaper panel. Generated wallpapers also offer 4K desktop and My screen.
steps.macBody: Open System Settings → Wallpaper → Add Photo, then choose the saved image.
steps.windowsBody: Right-click the saved image and choose Set as desktop background.
steps.iconsBody: Download the icon ZIP and extract it. Transfer the PNGs to your phone to set them up there.

intro.saveBody: Save each image batch to Photos before you begin.
intro.shortcutsBody: Make a home screen shortcut for each app using your new icon.
intro.hideBody: Press and hold an original icon, choose Remove App, then Remove from Home Screen. The app stays in your App Library.
intro.wallpaperBody: Open your saved wallpaper in Photos, tap Share, then Use as Wallpaper.
